## Question
Is NIH making progress on the five goals of its Strategic Plan for Data Science, 2025–2030, and how would we know from public data alone?

## Data
- NIH ExPORTER: projects, abstracts, publication links, patents, and clinical studies, FY2015–FY2025 (FY2008+ for investigator history)
- [NIH Data Science Taxonomy](../skills/nlp-llms.qmd) labels for data science and AI
- Europe PMC, DataCite, iCite, and OpenAlex for papers, datasets, citations, and open access

## Method
The plan sets goals but does not publish metrics, so I proposed 28 KPIs. Each maps to a goal, uses a public source, and has a written formula and caveats. 23 come from NIH ExPORTER plus the taxonomy; 5 need other public APIs.

- **Shares** = numerator / denominator, by fiscal year and Institute or Center (IC). Example: C1 = data science projects / all NIH projects
- **Funding** = total cost in nominal USD, excluding subprojects; intramural (Z) and contract (N) projects excluded from denominators
- **Outcomes** compare data science projects with other projects in the same fiscal year

| ID | KPI | Goal | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Data science share of NIH projects | Context | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| C2 | Data science share of NIH funding | Context | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| C3 | AI share of data science projects | Context | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| C4 | RCDC Machine Learning and AI funding | Context | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| C5 | Data science method mix | Context | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G1.1 | Data management and sharing in data science projects | Goal 1: Data management and sharing | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G1.2 | Papers with a data availability statement | Goal 1: Data management and sharing | Europe PMC full-text open access subset |
| G1.3 | Datasets crediting NIH | Goal 1: Data management and sharing | DataCite REST API (fundingReferences) |
| G2.1 | Projects using human-derived data resources | Goal 2: Human-derived data | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G2.2 | Projects naming NIH human data resources | Goal 2: Human-derived data | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G3.1 | Research software projects | Goal 3: Software, computational methods, and AI | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G3.2 | Papers that share code | Goal 3: Software, computational methods, and AI | Europe PMC full-text open access subset |
| G3.3 | Generative AI projects | Goal 3: Software, computational methods, and AI | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G3.4 | Responsible AI share | Goal 3: Software, computational methods, and AI | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G3.5 | Computational modeling and digital twins | Goal 3: Software, computational methods, and AI | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G4.1 | Infrastructure share of data science funding | Goal 4: Federated data infrastructure | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G4.2 | Projects naming NIH data platforms | Goal 4: Federated data infrastructure | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G4.3 | Cloud and high-performance computing projects | Goal 4: Federated data infrastructure | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G5.1 | Data science share of training projects | Goal 5: Data science community | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G5.2 | Transition from career award to independence | Goal 5: Data science community | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G5.3 | Breadth of institutions doing data science | Goal 5: Data science community | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G5.4 | New investigators in data science | Goal 5: Data science community | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| G5.5 | Data science capacity-building projects | Goal 5: Data science community | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| O1 | Publications per data science project | Outcomes | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| O2 | Citation impact of data science papers | Outcomes | iCite API |
| O3 | Open access share of data science papers | Outcomes | OpenAlex (open_access.is_oa) by PMID |
| O4 | Clinical trial link rate | Outcomes | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |
| O5 | Patent link rate | Outcomes | NIH ExPORTER + taxonomy |

**Abbreviations:** RCDC = Research, Condition, and Disease Categorization; RCR = Relative Citation Ratio; DMS = Data Management and Sharing; IDeA = Institutional Development Award states; EHR = electronic health record.
